notes.title: Major Update Out Now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386149/d88d69605241f2608042ae0576318a54e7d3fa57.png
Happy Chinese New Year, everyone!

It's finally time for the long-awaited major update!

In this update, we've added the new side story "Rin and the Mysterious Challenge", new date conversations, a handy backlog function where you can read past conversations, a new "Cooking Inspiration" feature, and some quirky new NPCs!

And of course, we've also rolled out various bug fixes and QOL improvements. We hope you enjoy the new additions to the world of Maid Cafe on Electric Street!

Don't forget, we're also joining the Taipei Game Show sale, where the game and soundtrack are both 20% OFF until 10:00 AM February 4, 2025 (PST)! Don't miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1789030/_/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320210/_/

Side Story: Rin and the Mysterious Challenge

You and Rin Arisugawa follow the black cat into Togetsuya, but find yourself trapped inside! Can you escape with Rin safely?!

This is a new escape room scenario with some tricky riddles to solve, so it's time to put on your thinking cap!

The new side story can be accessed from the title screen.

New Date Conversations

We've added a lot of new dialogue with other characters for when you go on dates with your maids!

Now you can enjoy chatting with the residents of Electric Street and your best girl even more.

Backlog Function

We've added a way to read conversations you might have accidentally skipped or otherwise want to reread: the backlog!

It'll be useful in the side story too, since there might be hints in your conversations...

New Feature: Cooking Inspiration

Eating food items or eating out at restaurants can now grant you Cooking Inspiration!

The Cooking Inspiration you've collected can be used in the cafe management menu to attempt to raise your cafe's overall culinary skill. The more Cooking Inspiration you have, the higher the success rate, while spending 100 or more Cooking Inspiration guarantees a success.

The overall culinary skill can be raised at most 5 times, and this makes cooking just a little quicker during opening hours!

Quirky New Original NPCs

We've added new original NPCs inspired from friends of the development team!

They'll appear on Electric Street and visit the cafe during management mode, so even if you've already beaten the game, you should still go and pay them a visit!

Improvements, Fixes, and Additions

Added the names of players who have participated in the campaign to find Adventurer's Tavern to the credits.
Made it so that in-game CGs are correctly saved to the cloud.
Fixed several bugs reported by the community.

notes.title: Find Adventurer's Tavern to Get Your Name in the Credits!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

Did you know? The developer's room "Adventurer's Tavern" is hidden somewhere on Electric Street... and it's so well-hidden, most of our players haven't found it yet!

Which is why we're holding a campaign where the first 15 players who tell us how they find it will have their names added to the game's end credits!

Campaign Details:
The first 15 players who find Adventurer's Tavern and tell us how they got there can get their names added to the end credits of the game!

In order to qualify for this campaign, please make sure to send us a DM on X (formerly Twitter) that contains the following information:
[olist]
A screenshot of Adventurer's Tavern.
How you entered Adventurer's Tavern. (Please tell us in detail, step by step!)
Anything that allows us to check your Steam account to confirm that you've gotten the achievement. (And so that we can add your Steam name to the credits!)
[/olist]
This campaign will last until we've received 15 valid entries. Good luck finding the Adventurer's Tavern, managers!

notes.title: Introducing the IRL and Indie Game Collabs! (Part 1)

notes.title: Maid Cafe on Electric Street to be Released on November 18, 2024!
notes.content:
Maid Cafe on Electric Street to be Released on November 18, 2024!

[previewyoutube=NJgQics6_Yc;full][/previewyoutube]

Fuwa Fuwa Cafe—a maid cafe tucked away in a quiet part of Nipponbashi, and where a wonderful encounter is about to take place...

You, the protagonist, quit your job at an extremely toxic workplace and find yourself at a run-down maid cafe, where a cute maid named Shiro works.

At first, you only agree to become the new manager because it conveniently met all your urgent needs, but soon the colorful maids Miyu, Favna, and Honoka join in. And as you spend time with them and meet the people of Electric Street, both you and the cafe will gradually liven up once more.

Maid Cafe on Electric Street is a story-focused adventure game where you enjoy daily life at Fuwa Fuwa Cafe. Make yourself a cup of coffee, relax, and immerse yourself in a heartwarming story.

The game will soon be released on Steam on November 18, 2024!

Maid Voice Cast Revealed! Demo to be Updated to Voiced Version

The four maids will be voiced by Ikumi Hasegawa (Shiro), Ayasa Itou (Miyu), Sayumi Suzushiro (Favna), and Yui Ishikawa (Honoka).

This all-star voice cast has added even more dramatic flair to the story and make it all the more immersive!

Shiro (VA: Ikumi Hasegawa)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386149/1f1922ad3408bfeef987ffc2069e9c0e17be9fba.jpg
Miyu (VA: Ayasa Itou)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386149/a832f740d0ff1d0abde037c81a82dd3b2fc955b9.jpg
Favna (VA: Sayumi Suzushiro)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386149/1db1bdd39b222a58e939c1f6b22cf0655e9be65d.jpg
Honoka (VA: Yui Ishikawa)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386149/3a4ae32f5e0b33ac8ef56c6f85ef164f23b197a2.jpg

With this announcement, we’ve also updated the demo to include character voices!

Enjoy the newly-voiced beginning of the story in the free demo with your favorite cup of coffee.

(The demo can be downloaded from the Steam page, but demo data cannot be carried over to the full game.)
 
Collaborating with Real Stores in Nipponbashi... and Other Indies!

Since Maid Cafe on Electric Street is a leisurely maid cafe adventure set in Nipponbashi, Osaka, we have collaborated with several stores that you can find both in-game and in real-life Nipponbashi! Of course, you can shop and eat at these places just like you can at the real ones.

What’s more, we have also collaborated with several indie games. You can collect merchandise of different indie games by buying them from capsule toy machines and stores!

More collaboration details will be announced on the developer’s official X (former Twitter) account as well as in the Steam community news, so keep an eye out for that!

notes.title: Gamepad Compatibility Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have updated the demo of Maid Cafe on Electric Street to add gamepad compatibility*.

Certain in-game text tutorials only include keyboard controls, but we plan on adding gamepad controls to the tutorials in a future update.

Gamepad Controls:

A Button: Confirm, Interact, End Interaction
B Button: Cancel
Y Button: Chat (Talk with whoever is accompanying you)
Left Stick: Movement
Directional Pad Up: Open Backpack
Directional Pad Down: Use Smartphone

*An Xbox controller is recommended.

notes.title: Maid Cafe on Electric Street Joins Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386149/1d58566bb936ab8d49e875cb6d64ffd096c64d13.png

We've released a demo for Maid Cafe on Electric Street, the leisurely maid cafe adventure set in the otaku haven of Nipponbashi, Osaka, for Steam Next Fest!

There are still a lot of unfinished features and places that still need tweaking, but the demo showcases the beginning of the game's story as well as date events with the maids and cafe management gameplay. 

We hope you'll enjoy the sneak peek of life with Shiro, Miyu, Favna, and Honoka!
